name: Death Certificate
description: Official certificate recording the death of a person. This is the starting certificate for workflows related to inheritance, legal heir determination, property transfer, pensions, and succession.

required_documents.name: Medical Certificate of Cause of Death

common_rejection_reasons: Required medical death certificate is missing
Applicant identity information does not match the application
Death details could not be verified
next_step: Apply for a Legal Heir Certificate if inheritance or property-related services are required.
citizen_guidance: Obtain the Death Certificate first. It is commonly required as a prerequisite for determining legal heirs and starting inheritance-related processes.

name: Legal Heir Certificate
description: Certificate identifying the surviving legal heirs of a deceased person for purposes such as inheritance, pensions, benefits, and property-related processes.

prerequisites.reason: The deceased person's death must be officially established before legal heirs can be determined.

required_documents.name: Proof of Relationship to the Deceased

common_rejection_reasons: Death Certificate is missing or cannot be verified
Required family member information is incomplete
Applicant identity or address cannot be verified
next_step: If the deceased owned property, use the Legal Heir Certificate to begin the property mutation process.
citizen_guidance: Do not start the property mutation application until you have the Legal Heir Certificate if the mutation workflow requires it.

name: Property Mutation
description: Process for updating land or property records to reflect the transfer of ownership or interest following the death of a property owner.

prerequisites.reason: The previous property holder's death must be established.
The legal heirs must be identified before the property record can be updated.

common_rejection_reasons: Death Certificate is missing or cannot be verified
Legal Heir Certificate is missing or cannot be verified
Property ownership records do not match the application
Property details are incomplete or inconsistent
next_step: If a succession process is required, proceed to the Succession Certificate workflow after completing the applicable property and heir-record requirements.
citizen_guidance: Before applying for mutation, make sure you have the Death Certificate and Legal Heir Certificate. Applying without these prerequisites may result in rejection.

name: Marriage Eligibility Confirmation
description: Confirmation that the parties meet the synthetic workflow conditions for marriage registration.

prerequisites.reason: Both people must be identified before their eligibility can be reviewed.

common_rejection_reasons: Date of birth evidence is inconsistent
next_step: Submit the marriage notice once eligibility is confirmed.
citizen_guidance: Do not submit a marriage notice until the identity and eligibility checks are complete.

name: Marriage Notice Submission
description: Submission of a synthetic notice that starts the marriage registration review period.

prerequisites.reason: Eligibility must be confirmed before a marriage notice can be accepted.

next_step: Proceed to marriage registration after the notice review is complete.
citizen_guidance: Keep the notice record available; it is required for the registration application.

name: Marriage Registration
description: Registration of a marriage after the notice and required supporting documents have been accepted.

prerequisites.reason: An accepted marriage notice is required before registration.

next_step: Request the Marriage Certificate after the registration record is issued.
citizen_guidance: Bring all required witness and ceremony evidence to avoid a delayed registration.

name: Marriage Certificate
description: Certificate confirming the completed synthetic marriage registration.

prerequisites.reason: A completed marriage registration record is required before a certificate can be issued.

next_step: Use the Marriage Certificate for any optional record updates or joint property requests.
citizen_guidance: Keep a copy of the Marriage Certificate; it is the prerequisite for marriage-related record updates in this sample workflow.

name: Marriage-Related Name Update
description: Optional update of a person's name in a synthetic civic record after marriage.

prerequisites.reason: The marriage must be documented before a marriage-related name update can be considered.

common_rejection_reasons: Current identity proof does not match the request
next_step: No further step is required in this sample name-update workflow.
citizen_guidance: This is optional. Apply only when you want a civic record to reflect a name change related to marriage.

name: Joint Property Interest Declaration
description: Declaration of a spouse's interest in an existing property record for a synthetic joint-property workflow.

prerequisites.reason: The relationship must be documented before a joint-property interest can be declared.

next_step: Apply for a joint property record update after the declaration is accepted.
citizen_guidance: This declaration does not itself change ownership; it prepares the required evidence for the next record-update step.

name: Property Record Search
description: Search and retrieval of a synthetic property record needed before a property workflow begins.
common_rejection_reasons: No matching property record was found
next_step: Verify the property ownership details using the record extract.
citizen_guidance: Start with an accurate property location description so the correct record can be located.

name: Property Ownership Verification
description: Verification of the current recorded ownership before a synthetic property transfer or update request.

prerequisites.reason: A property record extract is needed to verify the current recorded owner.

common_rejection_reasons: Requester identity does not match the claim
next_step: Submit a property transfer declaration or the applicable property record update request.
citizen_guidance: Do not begin a property transfer request until the current ownership record has been verified.

name: Property Transfer Declaration
description: Declaration of the parties and terms for a synthetic property transfer workflow.

prerequisites.reason: Current ownership must be verified before a transfer can be declared.

next_step: Request property transfer clearance after the declaration is accepted.
citizen_guidance: Ensure the proposed recipient details match the transfer declaration before submission.

name: Property Transfer Clearance
description: Review of the synthetic property transfer request for missing documents and unresolved record conflicts.

prerequisites.reason: A submitted transfer declaration is required before clearance review.
The current property record must be available for clearance review.

common_rejection_reasons: Property record details conflict with the request
next_step: Register the property transfer after clearance is issued.
citizen_guidance: Clearance checks the record and evidence before registration, helping prevent a failed final submission.

name: Property Transfer Registration
description: Registration of an approved synthetic transfer of property interest.

prerequisites.reason: Transfer clearance must be issued before registration.

next_step: Apply to update the property record after the transfer is registered.
citizen_guidance: Registration records the transfer; the property record still needs its separate update step.

name: Property Record Mutation
description: Update of a synthetic property record after a registered property transfer.

prerequisites.reason: The transfer must be registered before the property record can be updated.
The current property record must be available before it can be updated.

common_rejection_reasons: Property record update request is incomplete
next_step: Update the synthetic property account after the record mutation is complete.
citizen_guidance: Do not assume registration alone updates the property record; submit this separate update request.

name: Joint Property Record Update
description: Update of a synthetic property record to include a documented joint property interest after marriage.

prerequisites.reason: A joint-property interest must be declared before the record can be updated.
Current ownership must be verified before a joint record update.

common_rejection_reasons: Joint property interest declaration is missing
Joint property update request is incomplete
next_step: No further step is required in this sample joint-property workflow.
citizen_guidance: Both the marriage-related declaration and the existing ownership verification are required; neither replaces the other.

name: Property Account Update
description: Final synthetic account update after a property record mutation or joint property record update.

prerequisites.reason: A completed property record mutation can support the account update.

common_rejection_reasons: Property account update request is incomplete
Account holder identity cannot be verified
next_step: No further step is required in this sample property account workflow.
citizen_guidance: Complete the record update first, then use its result to update the related synthetic property account.
